examples.target: 求知慾是每個好奇小孩與生俱來的本能。

examples.source: Humans are hard-wired in their brains to recognize familiar faces quickly.
examples.target: 人類大腦與生俱來就能夠快速辨認熟悉的面孔。

examples.source: The need for social connection is hard-wired in our human nature.
examples.target: 對社交聯繫的需求是我們人類與生俱來的本性。

examples.source: Too much sunlight can harm your skin if you do not wear sunscreen.
examples.target: 如果你不塗防曬霜，過多的陽光會傷害你的皮膚。

examples.source: Eating too much junk food will harm your health in the long run.
examples.target: 長期吃太多零食會對你的健康造成損害。

examples.source: The new school rules are not meant to harm the students' personal freedom.
examples.target: 新的校規並非旨在損害學生的個人自由。

examples.source: Too much sun exposure can do serious harm to your skin.
examples.target: 過度曝曬在陽光下會對你的皮膚造成嚴重傷害。

examples.source: It is important to protect children from any potential harm.
examples.target: 保護兒童免受任何潛在的傷害是非常重要的。

examples.source: The new safety rules were made to prevent harm at school.
examples.target: 制定這些新的安全規則是為了防止在學校發生傷害。

examples.source: Too much screen time can harm your eyes after a long day.
examples.target: 長時間對著屏幕，可能會在一天結束後損害你的視力。

examples.source: Please be careful not to harm the flowers in the school garden.
examples.target: 請小心，不要損害學校花園裡的花朵。

examples.source: Pollution will harm the environment and affect the health of many people.
examples.target: 污染會損害環境，並影響許多人的健康。

examples.source: Please be careful not to harm the plants in the school garden.
examples.target: 請小心，不要傷害到學校花園裡的植物。

examples.source: Lying to your best friend will only harm your relationship with them.
examples.target: 對你最好的朋友撒謊，只會傷害你們之間的關係。

examples.source: The new rules are designed to protect students and harm no one.
examples.target: 這些新規則旨在保護學生，不會傷害任何人。

examples.source: Too much sun exposure can cause serious harm to your delicate skin.
examples.target: 過度曝曬陽光可能會對你嬌嫩的皮膚造成嚴重損害。

examples.source: We should protect the environment to prevent further harm to nature.
examples.target: 我們應該保護環境，以防止對大自然造成進一步的損害。

examples.source: Eating too much junk food will do more harm than good to you.
examples.target: 吃太多零食對你來說是弊大於利，會造成損害。

examples.source: Smoking is harmful to your health and should be avoided by everyone.
examples.target: 吸煙對你的健康有害，每個人都應該避免。

examples.source: Too much screen time can be harmful to your eyes and sleep quality.
examples.target: 過多的螢幕時間可能會對你的眼睛和睡眠質素有害。

examples.source: We must protect the environment from harmful chemicals and plastic waste pollution.
examples.target: 我們必須保護環境，免受有害化學物質和塑膠廢料的污染。

has been noun/adjective.meaning: 一直是 / 一直處於某狀態

examples.source: My best friend has been a member of the school basketball team.
examples.target: 我最好的朋友一直都是校隊的籃球隊員。

examples.source: This quiet library has been my favorite place to study after school.
examples.target: 這間安靜的圖書館一直是我放學後最喜歡溫習的地方。

examples.source: Learning a new language has been a difficult challenge for many students.
examples.target: 學習一門新語言對許多學生來說一直是一項艱鉅的挑戰。

examples.source: My teacher has been to Japan many times for her summer holidays.
examples.target: 我的老師暑假期間去過日本很多次。

examples.source: None of my classmates has been to that new museum in town yet.
examples.target: 我的同學之中，還沒有人去過城中那間新博物館。

examples.source: She has been to the library twice this week to study for exams.
examples.target: 她這星期已經去過圖書館兩次，為了準備考試。

examples.source: My bad grade has nothing to do with my teacher's teaching style.
examples.target: 我成績差與老師的教學風格無關。

examples.source: His decision to quit the team has nothing to do with us.
examples.target: 他決定退出球隊與我們無關。

examples.source: The delay in our project has nothing to do with the weather.
examples.target: 我們項目的延誤與天氣無關。

examples.source: His bad mood today has something to do with his failed math test.
examples.target: 他今天心情不好，與他數學測驗不及格有關。

examples.source: The rise in local temperature has something to do with climate change.
examples.target: 本地氣溫上升與氣候變化有關。

examples.source: This new school rule has something to do with our recent safety concerns.
examples.target: 這條新校規與我們最近關注的安全問題有關。

examples.source: This science project has to do with how plants grow in the dark.
examples.target: 這個科學專題研習與植物如何在黑暗中生長有關。

examples.source: My bad mood today has to do with the difficult math test earlier.
examples.target: 我今天心情不好，與早前那場艱深的數學測驗有關。

examples.source: The new school rule has to do with keeping our campus clean daily.
examples.target: 這條新校規與保持校園每日整潔有關。

examples.source: I think my best friend has a crush on the new student.
examples.target: 我覺得我最好的朋友暗戀那位新來的學生。

examples.source: It is not a secret that he has a crush on her.
examples.target: 他暗戀她的事已經不是什麼秘密了。

examples.source: She has had a crush on that pop singer for three years.
examples.target: 她迷戀那位流行歌手已經有三年了。

have a high ego.meaning: 自我很強 / 自視過高

examples.source: He tends to have a high ego and rarely listens to others' advice.
examples.target: 他為人比較自視過高，很少聽取別人的意見。

examples.source: You should not have a high ego if you want to work well.
examples.target: 如果你想與人合作順利，就不應該自視過高。

examples.source: She has a high ego, so she finds it hard to admit mistakes.
examples.target: 她因為自我太強，所以很難承認自己犯錯。

examples.source: I have a hunch that our math test will be quite difficult today.
examples.target: 我有一種預感，今天的數學測驗會相當困難。

examples.source: She had a hunch that she would meet her old friend at school.
examples.target: 她當時有一種預感，覺得自己會在學校遇見那位舊朋友。

examples.source: Do you have a hunch about who will win the school singing contest?
examples.target: 你有沒有預感誰會贏得這次的校內歌唱比賽？

examples.source: My younger brother seems to have a liking for playing online video games.
examples.target: 我弟弟好像對玩網上遊戲很有興趣。

examples.source: Many students have a liking for reading mystery novels during their lunch break.
examples.target: 很多學生都喜歡在午休時間閱讀懸疑小說。

examples.source: She does not have a liking for spicy food, so she avoids Thai restaurants.
examples.target: 她不太喜歡吃辣，所以她通常會避免去泰國餐廳。

examples.source: Your success in exams has a lot to do with daily revision.
examples.target: 你的考試成功與每日溫習有很大關係。

examples.source: His good performance has a lot to do with practice.
examples.target: 他的好表現與練習有很大關係。

examples.source: My interest in science has a lot to do with my primary teacher.
examples.target: 我對科學的興趣與我的小學老師有很大關係。

examples.source: My sister has a sweet tooth, so she eats chocolate every single day.
examples.target: 我妹妹很喜歡甜食，所以她每天都會吃巧克力。

examples.source: Since I have a sweet tooth, I always order a dessert after dinner.
examples.target: 因為我很喜歡甜食，所以我晚飯後總會點一份甜品。

examples.source: Most of my friends have a sweet tooth and love visiting cake shops.
examples.target: 我的朋友們大多很喜歡甜食，而且很愛去蛋糕店。

examples.source: The weather has been hot lately, so please drink plenty of water.
examples.target: 最近天氣變得好熱，所以請記得多喝水。

examples.source: My younger brother has been quiet since he came home from school.
examples.target: 我弟弟自從放學回家後就變得好安靜。

examples.source: The streets have been busy because of the annual summer night market.
examples.target: 因為一年一度的夏季夜市，街道變得好熱鬧。

examples.source: My best friend has been a great support during my difficult exams.
examples.target: 在我考試困難的時候，我最好的朋友一直是非常好的支持。

examples.source: Learning a new language has been a challenging but rewarding experience lately.
examples.target: 學習新語言一直是一項充滿挑戰但有收穫的體驗。

examples.source: This local park has been a popular place for students to study.
examples.target: 這個地區公園一直是一個受學生歡迎的溫習地方。

examples.source: I have been busy with my school projects for the entire week.
examples.target: 我這整個星期都忙於學校的專題習作。

examples.source: They have been friends since they started secondary school three years ago.
examples.target: 他們自從三年前升中學開始就一直是好朋友。

examples.source: We have been tired after playing basketball in the hot sun today.
examples.target: 我們今天在烈日下打完籃球後都感到很疲倦。

examples.source: My best friend has been a member of the school choir for years.
examples.target: 我最好的朋友已經是學校合唱團的成員好幾年了。

examples.source: This old library has been a quiet place for students to study lately.
examples.target: 這間舊圖書館最近已經是學生們安靜溫習的好地方。

examples.source: Mr. Chan has been our basketball coach since I joined the school team.
examples.target: 自從我加入校隊以來，陳老師已經是我們的籃球教練了。

examples.source: You should have faith in your ability to solve this difficult math problem.
examples.target: 你應該對自己解決這道數學難題的能力有信心。

examples.source: Our teacher has faith in us and knows we will pass the exam.
examples.target: 老師對我們有信心，並相信我們一定能通過考試。

examples.source: I have faith in my teammates, so I know we can win today.
examples.target: 我對隊友有信心，所以我知道我們今天一定能贏。

examples.source: My parents have gone to the supermarket to buy some fresh fruit.
examples.target: 我父母已經去了超級市場買些新鮮水果。

examples.source: All my classmates have gone to the library to finish their project.
examples.target: 我所有同學都去了圖書館完成他們的專題報告。

examples.source: The teacher said that the principal has gone to a meeting today.
examples.target: 老師說校長今天去了開會。

have no alternative / choice but to.meaning: 只好 / 別無選擇只好

examples.source: The bus did not come, so I had no choice but to walk.
examples.target: 巴士沒有來，所以我別無選擇，只好步行。

examples.source: We had no choice but to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
examples.target: 因為下雨，我們別無選擇，只好取消野餐。

examples.source: I forgot my lunch, so I had no choice but to buy a sandwich.
examples.target: 我忘記帶午餐，所以只好買一個三文治。

have no alternative but to.meaning: 只好 / 別無選擇只好

examples.source: The bus broke down, so I had no alternative but to walk home.
examples.target: 巴士故障了，所以我別無選擇，只好步行回家。

examples.source: We had no alternative but to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
examples.target: 因為下雨，我們別無選擇，只好取消野餐。

examples.source: The shop was closed, so I had no alternative but to buy it online.
examples.target: 店舖關門了，所以我別無選擇，只好在網上購買。

have no choice / alternative but to.meaning: 只好 / 別無選擇只好

examples.source: The bus did not come, so I had no choice but to walk.
examples.target: 巴士沒有來，所以我別無選擇，只好步行。

examples.source: We had no choice but to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
examples.target: 因為下雨，我們別無選擇，只好取消野餐。

examples.source: I forgot my lunch, so I had no choice but to buy a sandwich.
examples.target: 我忘記帶午餐，所以只好買一個三文治。

examples.source: The bus broke down, so I had no choice but to walk home.
examples.target: 巴士壞了，所以我別無選擇，只好走路回家。

examples.source: It started raining, so we had no choice but to cancel the picnic.
examples.target: 開始下雨了，我們別無選擇，只好取消野餐。

examples.source: I forgot my homework, so I had no choice but to apologize to him.
examples.target: 我忘記帶功課，所以別無選擇，只好向他道歉。

have no choice but to.meaning: 只好 / 別無選擇只好

examples.source: The bus did not come, so I had no choice but to walk.
examples.target: 巴士沒有來，所以我別無選擇，只好步行。

examples.source: We had no choice but to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
examples.target: 因為下雨，我們別無選擇，只好取消野餐。

have no choice but to / have no alternat.meaning: 只好 / 別無選擇只好

examples.source: The bus did not come, so I had no choice but to walk.
examples.target: 巴士沒有來，所以我別無選擇，只好步行。

examples.source: We had no choice but to cancel the picnic because of the rain.
examples.target: 因為下雨，我們別無選擇，只好取消野餐。

examples.source: I forgot my lunch, so I had no choice but to buy a sandwich.
examples.target: 我忘記帶午餐，所以只好買一個三文治。

examples.source: My bad grades have nothing to do with my teacher's teaching style.
examples.target: 我成績差與老師的教學風格無關。

examples.source: This problem has nothing to do with the rules of the game.
examples.target: 這個問題與遊戲規則無關。

examples.source: His decision has nothing to do with what I said yesterday.
examples.target: 他的決定與我昨天說的話無關。

examples.source: His bad mood seems to have something to do with the exam results.
examples.target: 他的心情不好，似乎與考試成績有關。

examples.source: Does this change have something to do with our new school policy?
examples.target: 這個改變是否與我們學校的新政策有關？

examples.source: The traffic delay had something to do with the heavy rain this morning.
examples.target: 交通延誤與今早的大雨有關。

examples.source: Have you ever wondered why the sky is blue during the day?
examples.target: 你有沒有想過為什麼白天的天空是藍色的？

examples.source: Have you ever wondered how it feels to travel to outer space?
examples.target: 你有沒有想過到外太空旅行是什麼感覺？

examples.source: Have you ever wondered what our school will look like in future?
examples.target: 你有沒有想過我們學校未來會變成什麼樣子？

examples.source: I love playing basketball; having said that, I must finish my homework first.
examples.target: 我很喜歡打籃球；話雖這樣，我必須先完成功課。

examples.source: The movie was quite long; having said that, it was still very interesting.
examples.target: 這套電影相當長；話雖這樣，它仍然非常有趣。

examples.source: It is a difficult task; having said that, we should try our best.
examples.target: 這是一項艱巨的任務；話雖這樣，我們還是應該盡力而為。

examples.source: The company decided to move its headquarters to a new office building.
examples.target: 這間公司決定將總部搬到一棟新的辦公大樓。

examples.source: We visited the bank's headquarters during our school field trip last week.
examples.target: 我們上星期學校旅行時參觀了那間銀行的總部。

examples.source: All major decisions are made by the managers at the global headquarters.
examples.target: 所有重要的決定都是由全球總部的經理們所作出的。

examples.source: The government is working hard to improve the quality of local healthcare.
examples.target: 政府正努力提升本地醫療保健的質素。

examples.source: Good healthcare is essential for everyone to maintain a healthy and active lifestyle.
examples.target: 良好的醫療保健對每個人維持健康和活躍的生活方式都至關重要。

examples.source: My sister wants to study healthcare because she enjoys helping sick people recover.
examples.target: 我姐姐想修讀醫療保健，因為她喜歡幫助病人康復。

examples.source: The court will hold a hearing to discuss the case next Monday morning.
examples.target: 法庭將於下星期一早上舉行聆訊，以討論這宗案件。

examples.source: She prepared all the necessary documents for her formal hearing at the office.
examples.target: 她為辦公室的正式聽證會準備了所有必要的文件。

examples.source: The committee scheduled a public hearing to listen to the students' new ideas.
examples.target: 委員會安排了一場公開聽證會，以聆聽學生們的新想法。

examples.source: The doctor tested my hearing to ensure I could listen to lessons clearly.
examples.target: 醫生測試了我的聽力，以確保我能清楚地聽課。

examples.source: You should protect your hearing by not listening to music at high volumes.
examples.target: 你不應該用太大聲聽音樂，以免損害你的聽力。

examples.source: My hearing has improved since I started sitting in the front of class.
examples.target: 自從我開始坐在課室前排後，我的聽力情況改善了不少。

examples.source: Eating this delicious chocolate cake feels like a little slice of heaven.
examples.target: 吃這塊美味的朱古力蛋糕，感覺就像置身於天堂一樣。

examples.source: After a long day of hiking, the cool breeze felt like heaven to us.
examples.target: 經過一整天的遠足後，涼爽的微風對我們來說簡直是天堂般的享受。

examples.source: The beautiful beach with clear blue water looked like a little heaven on earth.
examples.target: 那個擁有清澈藍水的漂亮海灘，看起來就像人間天堂一樣。

examples.source: She broke the heel of her shoe while walking to school today.
examples.target: 她今天上學途中弄斷了鞋跟。

examples.source: These boots have a very low heel, so they are comfortable enough.
examples.target: 這對靴子的鞋跟很低，所以穿起來挺舒服的。

examples.source: I need to go to the repair shop to fix my broken heel.
examples.target: 我需要去維修店修理我那斷掉的鞋跟。

examples.source: I have a painful blister on my heel from my new school shoes.
examples.target: 我對新校鞋磨損了腳跟，長了一個很痛的水泡。

examples.source: She accidentally stepped on my heel while we were walking to class.
examples.target: 我們走去課室的時候，她不小心踩到了我的腳跟。

examples.source: The doctor told me to stretch my heel to prevent any sports injuries.
examples.target: 醫生叫我拉伸腳跟，以預防運動時受傷。

examples.source: Waiting for the bus in the heat felt extremely uncomfortable.
examples.target: 在炎熱天氣下等巴士感覺極不舒服。

examples.source: The final exam week felt very stressful for the students.
examples.target: 期末考試週令學生感到很大壓力。

examples.source: The headache made the whole day feel very difficult.
examples.target: 頭痛令整天都變得很難受。

examples.source: Studying for several difficult exams at once was a painful experience.
examples.target: 同時準備幾個艱深考試是一段痛苦的經歷。

examples.source: The long bus ride in the hot weather was extremely uncomfortable.
examples.target: 炎熱天氣下的長途巴士車程非常難受。

examples.source: Trying to finish all the work before midnight was very stressful.
examples.target: 嘗試在午夜前完成所有工作非常有壓力。

examples.source: You must wear a helmet when you are riding your bicycle today.
examples.target: 你今天騎單車的時候，必須要戴上頭盔。

examples.source: The construction worker put on his yellow helmet before entering the site.
examples.target: 建築工人在進入工地前，戴上了他的黃色頭盔。

examples.source: Remember to fasten your helmet strap tightly to keep yourself safe while cycling.
examples.target: 記得要扣緊頭盔帶，以確保你在騎車時的安全。

examples.source: He forgot his umbrella, hence he got wet in the heavy rain.
examples.target: 他忘記帶雨傘，因此在傾盆大雨中全身濕透了。

examples.source: The bus was delayed, hence we arrived at school a bit late.
examples.target: 巴士延誤了，因此我們上學遲到了一點。

examples.source: She studied very hard, hence she achieved an excellent grade this time.
examples.target: 她非常努力溫習，因此這次取得了優異的成績。

examples.source: It started to rain heavily, hence we decided to cancel the picnic.
examples.target: 當時開始下大雨，因此我們決定取消這次野餐。

examples.source: He forgot to set his alarm, hence he was late for school.
examples.target: 他忘記設定鬧鐘，所以上學遲到了。

examples.source: The library was closed for repairs, hence I went home to study.
examples.target: 圖書館因為維修而關閉，因此我回家溫習功課。

examples.source: My mother grows fresh herb plants in pots on our small balcony.
examples.target: 我媽媽在我們的小露台上用花盆種植新鮮的香草。

examples.source: The doctor suggested drinking this Chinese herb tea to help me recover.
examples.target: 醫生建議我喝這種中草藥茶，以幫助我恢復健康。

examples.source: You can add a little dried herb to make the soup taste better.

examples.target: 她為最好的朋友買了一份漂亮的手製禮物。

examples.target: 這些手製曲奇比商店買的味道好多了。

examples.target: 我祖母每個星期日都會做手工麵當午餐。

hands-on.meaning: 親身實踐的 / 動手做的

examples.target: 這個科學項目為學生提供了很好的動手做機會。

examples.target: 我比較喜歡動手做的活動，因為它們更有趣。

hands-on.meaning: 親身參與的 / 實際操作的

examples.target: 這堂實際操作課幫助我們更清楚地理解科學。

hands-on workshop.meaning: 實作工作坊 / 親身體驗工作坊

hang out online.meaning: 在網上閒逛 / 消磨時間

hold someone back.meaning: 阻礙某人 / 使某人退縮

examples.source: Fear can hold someone back from trying new things.
examples.target: 恐懼會阻礙某人嘗試新事物。

examples.source: Do not let one mistake hold you back.
examples.target: 不要讓一個錯誤使你退縮。

examples.source: Lack of confidence held her back in interviews.
examples.target: 缺乏自信在面試中阻礙了她。

hook someone to.meaning: 把某人接上 / 連接到

examples.source: The nurse hooked the patient to a monitor.
examples.target: 護士把病人接上監測器。

examples.source: The trainer hooked the climber to a safety rope.
examples.target: 教練把攀爬者連接到安全繩。

examples.source: The technician hooked him to the recording device.
examples.target: 技術員把他接上錄音設備。

examples.source: The health talk warned students about getting hooked on nicotine.
examples.target: 健康講座提醒學生不要對尼古丁上癮。

examples.source: People hooked on nicotine may need support to quit.
examples.target: 對尼古丁上癮的人可能需要支援戒掉。

examples.source: The poster shows the risks of being hooked on nicotine.
examples.target: 海報展示對尼古丁上癮的風險。

examples.source: The teacher asked the class to hush up before the test.
examples.target: 測驗前，老師叫全班安靜。

examples.source: He tried to hush up the noisy group.
examples.target: 他嘗試叫那群吵鬧的人收聲。

examples.source: Everyone hushed up when the principal entered.
examples.target: 校長進來時，大家都安靜下來。

hang on someone's every word.meaning: 對某人的話深信不疑 / 全神貫注聽某人說話

examples.source: The children hung on the storyteller's every word.
examples.target: 孩子們全神貫注聽說故事的人說話。

examples.source: Fans hung on the singer's every word.
examples.target: 粉絲對歌手的話深信不疑。

examples.source: The class hung on the teacher's every word during the story.
examples.target: 講故事時，全班全神貫注聽老師說話。

hang up one's racquet.meaning: 掛拍退役 / 結束網球生涯

examples.source: The champion decided to hang up her racquet.
examples.target: 冠軍決定掛拍退役。

examples.source: He hung up his racquet after twenty years.
examples.target: 二十年後，他結束網球生涯。

examples.source: Fans were sad when she hung up her racquet.
examples.target: 她掛拍退役時，粉絲都很傷心。

examples.source: He still hankers after a quieter life.
examples.target: 他仍然渴望更寧靜的生活。

examples.source: Many students hanker after freedom during the holidays.
examples.target: 很多學生在假期很想要自由。

examples.source: She hankered after the chance to study abroad.
examples.target: 她渴望有機會到海外讀書。

examples.source: Her speed is hard to match.
examples.target: 她的速度難以匹敵。

examples.source: The school's record is hard to match.
examples.target: 學校的紀錄難以匹敵。

examples.source: His knowledge of history is hard to match.
examples.target: 他的歷史知識難以匹敵。

examples.source: The result was hard to swallow.
examples.target: 這個結果難以接受。

examples.source: His excuse was hard to swallow.
examples.target: 他的藉口難以接受。

examples.source: It was hard to swallow that the project had failed.
examples.target: 項目失敗這件事令人難以接受。

examples.source: You would be hard-pressed to find a better example.
examples.target: 你很難找到更好的例子。

examples.source: The team was hard-pressed to finish on time.
examples.target: 團隊難以及時完成。

examples.source: She was hard-pressed to explain the strange result.
examples.target: 她難以解釋這個奇怪結果。

harken back to.meaning: 令人想起 / 回到過去

examples.source: The design harkens back to old Hong Kong.
examples.target: 這個設計令人想起舊香港。

examples.source: The song harkens back to her childhood.
examples.target: 這首歌令人想起她的童年。

examples.source: The story harkens back to a simpler time.
examples.target: 故事令人回到較簡單的過去。

examples.source: Sleep has a bearing on learning.
examples.target: 睡眠對學習有影響。

examples.source: The new rule has a bearing on every student.
examples.target: 新規則與每位學生有關。

examples.source: Family support can have a bearing on confidence.
examples.target: 家庭支持可以對自信有影響。

have a bee in one's bonnet.meaning: 對某事念念不忘 / 過分執著

examples.source: He has a bee in his bonnet about neat handwriting.
examples.target: 他對工整字跡過分執著。

examples.source: She has a bee in her bonnet about recycling.
examples.target: 她對回收念念不忘。

examples.source: The coach had a bee in his bonnet about punctuality.
examples.target: 教練對守時過分執著。

have a bridge to sell someone.meaning: 表示對方太易受騙 / 太天真

examples.source: If you believe that story, I have a bridge to sell you.
examples.target: 如果你相信那個故事，那你真是太天真了。

examples.source: He joked that he had a bridge to sell anyone who trusted the rumour.
examples.target: 他開玩笑說，誰相信那個謠言就是太易受騙。

examples.source: The phrase means someone is being too easily fooled.
examples.target: 這個詞語表示某人太易受騙。

have a good handle on.meaning: 掌握得好 / 了解得清楚

examples.source: She has a good handle on the grammar rules.
examples.target: 她對文法規則掌握得好。

examples.source: The team has a good handle on the problem.
examples.target: 團隊對問題了解得清楚。

examples.source: You need a good handle on the data before writing.
examples.target: 寫作前你需要清楚掌握數據。

have cause to.meaning: 有理由去 / 有原因去

examples.source: Parents have cause to worry about the delay.
examples.target: 家長有理由擔心延誤。

examples.source: The school had cause to review the rule.
examples.target: 學校有原因去檢討規則。

examples.source: She had cause to be proud of her progress.
examples.target: 她有理由為自己的進步自豪。

examples.source: She has exam revision down to a fine art.
examples.target: 她把考試溫習掌握得爐火純青。

examples.source: The chef has noodle-making down to a fine art.
examples.target: 廚師把製作麵條掌握得爐火純青。

examples.source: He has public speaking down to a fine art.
examples.target: 他把公開演講掌握得爐火純青。

have no bearing on.meaning: 與...無關 / 對...沒有影響

examples.source: His age has no bearing on his ability.
examples.target: 他的年齡與他的能力無關。

examples.source: The rumour has no bearing on the facts.
examples.target: 謠言與事實無關。

examples.source: The colour has no bearing on the quality.
examples.target: 顏色對質素沒有影響。

have no misgivings about.meaning: 對...毫無顧慮 / 不覺得不妥

examples.source: She had no misgivings about changing schools.
examples.target: 她對轉校毫無顧慮。

examples.source: The team had no misgivings about the new plan.
examples.target: 團隊不覺得新計劃有甚麼不妥。

examples.source: He had no misgivings about telling the truth.
examples.target: 他對說出真相毫無顧慮。

have one foot in.meaning: 一部分屬於 / 深受...影響

examples.source: The story has one foot in fantasy and one in history.
examples.target: 這故事一部分屬於奇幻，一部分屬於歷史。

examples.source: The design has one foot in traditional culture.
examples.target: 這設計深受傳統文化影響。

examples.source: She has one foot in art and one foot in science.
examples.target: 她一方面屬於藝術，一方面屬於科學。

examples.source: The team had its hopes dashed in the final minute.
examples.target: 隊伍在最後一分鐘希望破滅。

examples.source: She had her hopes dashed by the result.
examples.target: 結果令她希望破滅。

examples.source: Many fans had their hopes dashed after the announcement.
examples.target: 公布後，很多粉絲希望破滅。

have one's sights on.meaning: 把目標對準 / 意圖針對

examples.source: She has her sights on a place at university.
examples.target: 她把目標放在大學學位上。

examples.source: The team has its sights on the championship.
examples.target: 隊伍把目標對準冠軍。

examples.source: The writer has his sights on a younger audience.
examples.target: 作者意圖針對較年輕的讀者。

examples.source: He has his sights set on a scholarship.
examples.target: 他把目標放在獎學金上。

examples.source: The company has its sights set on overseas markets.
examples.target: 公司盯上海外市場。

examples.source: She has her sights set on becoming a doctor.
examples.target: 她把目標放在成為醫生上。

examples.source: She had her work up in the school hall.
examples.target: 她在學校禮堂展出自己的作品。

examples.source: The young artist had his work up for a week.
examples.target: 年輕藝術家展出自己的作品一星期。

examples.source: Students were proud to have their work up.
examples.target: 學生能展出自己的作品都感到自豪。

have some say in.meaning: 對...有一定發言權 / 有份決定

examples.source: Students should have some say in school events.
examples.target: 學生應對學校活動有一定發言權。

examples.source: Parents had some say in the new timetable.
examples.target: 家長對新時間表有份決定。

examples.source: The team wants to have some say in the final design.
examples.target: 團隊想對最終設計有一定發言權。

have someone covered.meaning: 能滿足某人的需要 / 幫某人安排好

examples.source: Do not worry about notes; I have you covered.
examples.target: 不用擔心筆記，我幫你安排好了。

examples.source: The guide has visitors covered with maps and tips.
examples.target: 指南用地圖和貼士滿足訪客需要。

examples.source: If you need practice, this app has you covered.
examples.target: 如果你需要練習，這個應用程式能滿足你的需要。

examples.source: The comedian had the audience in stitches.
examples.target: 喜劇演員令觀眾笑到停不了。

examples.source: Her funny story had us in stitches.
examples.target: 她的有趣故事令我們笑到停不了。

examples.source: The class was in stitches after his joke.
examples.target: 他說笑後，全班笑到停不了。

examples.source: She has too much on her plate this week.
examples.target: 她這星期有太多事情要處理。

examples.source: Do not add more work if you already have too much on your plate.
examples.target: 如果你已有太多事情要處理，就不要再加工作。

examples.source: The teacher had too much on her plate before exams.
examples.target: 考試前，老師有太多事情要處理。

heart is in the right place.meaning: 出發點是好的 / 心地是好的

examples.source: His plan was messy, but his heart was in the right place.
examples.target: 他的計劃很混亂，但出發點是好的。

examples.source: She made a mistake, but her heart is in the right place.
examples.target: 她犯了錯，但心地是好的。

examples.source: The volunteer's heart was in the right place.
examples.target: 義工的出發點是好的。

heave into view.meaning: 慢慢出現 / 漸漸進入視線

examples.source: The old ferry heaved into view through the fog.
examples.target: 舊渡輪在霧中慢慢進入視線。

examples.source: A mountain heaved into view as the clouds cleared.
examples.target: 雲散後，一座山漸漸進入視線。

examples.source: The stage heaved into view as the lights came on.
examples.target: 燈亮起時，舞台慢慢出現。

examples.source: The old teacher is held in high regard.
examples.target: 這位老教師備受尊敬。

examples.source: Her research is held in high regard by many experts.
examples.target: 她的研究備受很多專家尊敬。

examples.source: The charity is held in high regard in the community.
examples.target: 這間慈善機構在社區備受尊敬。

highly sought after.meaning: 非常搶手的 / 很受歡迎的

examples.source: Places in the course are highly sought after.
examples.target: 這課程的名額非常搶手。

examples.source: Her handmade notebooks are highly sought after.
examples.target: 她的手製筆記本很受歡迎。

examples.source: Good teachers are highly sought after.
examples.target: 好老師非常搶手。

hit on an idea.meaning: 偶然想到主意 / 想出點子

examples.source: She hit on an idea while walking home.
examples.target: 她回家途中偶然想到一個主意。

examples.source: The team hit on an idea for the poster.
examples.target: 團隊想出海報的點子。

examples.source: He hit on an idea after reading the article.
examples.target: 他讀完文章後想出一個點子。

hit the nail on the head.meaning: 說得完全正確 / 一針見血

examples.source: Her comment hit the nail on the head.
examples.target: 她的評論一針見血。

examples.source: You hit the nail on the head about the problem.
examples.target: 你對問題說得完全正確。

examples.source: The article hits the nail on the head.
examples.target: 文章說得一針見血。

hold a special place in one's heart.meaning: 在某人心中有特殊地位

examples.source: This school holds a special place in my heart.
examples.target: 這間學校在我心中有特殊地位。

examples.source: The old song holds a special place in her heart.
examples.target: 這首舊歌在她心中有特殊地位。

examples.source: The park holds a special place in our hearts.
examples.target: 這個公園在我們心中有特殊地位。

examples.source: She held her own in the debate.
examples.target: 她在辯論中不輸蝕。

examples.source: The young team held its own against stronger players.
examples.target: 年輕隊伍面對更強的球員仍能保持優勢。

examples.source: He can hold his own in difficult discussions.
examples.target: 他在困難討論中也不輸蝕。

examples.source: The family still held out hope for good news.
examples.target: 家人仍然抱有收到好消息的希望。

examples.source: Teachers hold out hope that every student can improve.
examples.target: 老師抱有每位學生都能進步的希望。

examples.source: We should not hold out hope for an easy answer.
examples.target: 我們不應指望有容易的答案。

hold someone accountable.meaning: 追究某人責任 / 要某人負責

examples.source: The rules hold students accountable for cheating.
examples.target: 規則會追究學生作弊的責任。

examples.source: A leader must be held accountable for decisions.
examples.target: 領袖必須為決定負責。

examples.source: The report holds the company accountable for the delay.
examples.target: 報告追究公司延誤的責任。

examples.source: She held to her promise.
examples.target: 她堅持自己的承諾。

examples.source: The writer holds to the view that practice matters.
examples.target: 作者持有練習很重要的立場。

examples.source: The school held to its original plan.
examples.target: 學校堅持原本計劃。

hold up a mirror to.meaning: 反映 / 映照出...的問題

examples.source: The novel holds up a mirror to modern society.
examples.target: 小說反映現代社會。

examples.source: The survey holds up a mirror to students' worries.
examples.target: 調查映照出學生的憂慮。

examples.source: Good films can hold up a mirror to our habits.
examples.target: 好電影可以反映我們的習慣。

hone one's craft.meaning: 磨練手藝 / 鍛鍊技術

examples.source: The writer hones her craft every day.
examples.target: 作者每天磨練自己的手藝。

examples.source: He joined the club to hone his craft.
examples.target: 他加入學會鍛鍊技術。

examples.source: Young musicians need time to hone their craft.
examples.target: 年輕音樂家需要時間磨練技藝。

hope on the horizon.meaning: 即將出現的希望 / 轉機

examples.source: There is hope on the horizon for the struggling team.
examples.target: 這支陷入困境的隊伍即將有轉機。

examples.source: The new medicine brought hope on the horizon.
examples.target: 新藥帶來即將出現的希望。

examples.source: After months of delay, there was finally hope on the horizon.
examples.target: 延誤數月後，終於有轉機。

examples.source: Her hunger for knowledge impressed the teacher.
examples.target: 她對知識的渴望令老師留下深刻印象。

examples.source: There is a hunger for better public spaces.
examples.target: 人們對更好的公共空間有需求。

examples.source: The article shows a hunger for change among young people.
examples.target: 文章顯示年輕人對改變的渴望。
